title: HIDDEN LAKE 622 | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties

description_expanded: Hidden Lake 622 – Coastal Luxury Condo with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Community Pool - Gym & Fitness Center - Near Beach About Hidden Lake 622: Welcome to Hidden Lake 622, a beautifully designed coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach—one of the area’s most peaceful and sought-after stretches known for its sugar-white sand and emerald waters. This spacious condo blends modern comfort with effortless beach living, featuring a bright open-concept layout, upscale finishes, and generously sized bedrooms with walk-in closets, making it perfect for families or groups traveling together. After a day at the beach, unwind on your private balcony with a coastal breeze, or take advantage of the resort-style amenities including a gated entrance, sparkling community pool, and a fitness center for staying active during your stay. Ideally located just minutes from beach access, local dining, coffee spots, and boutique shopping, Hidden Lake 622 offers the perfect balance of relaxation, convenience, and elevated coastal style—your ideal home base for an unforgettable 30A getaway.
